verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an AI workspace and document product, but the evidence pack documents no first-party bulk-action capability, such as multi-select deletes, batch embedding or batch workspace edits. The developer API for reading, writing and updating an instance is only a building block a developer could script against, so it earns no credit. A community user analysing 'a batch of regulatory PDFs' describes ordinary document use, not a documented bulk-operation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
